Added \\u0060OwnerScopedCoverage\\u0060 in the daemon\\u0027s AutoPrReview folder, which holds the single owner-scoped decision (\\u0060Decide\\u0060, \\u0060NewestOwn\\u0060, \\u0060IsOwn\\u0060, \\u0060ReadAsync\\u0060). It is used at all five covering-task checks in \\u0060AutoPrReviewEngine\\u0060, and \\u0060AttachMentionAsync\\u0060 re-checks ownership before it claims. Also added \\u0060ReviewMentionOutcome.CoveredByTeammate\\u0060, the needs-you row with no lever in \\u0060ReviewRequestPane\\u0060, tests, and docs.\\n- A node whose own owner has no root fingerprint yet treats every task as its own, mirroring \\u0060TaskOwnerGuard\\u0060 in the CLI. A task whose owner facts are unresolved on a node that does have a root counts as a teammate\\u0027s.\\n- A \\u0060CoveredByTeammate\\u0060 mention is stored with a null \\u0060TaskId\\u0060. Anything that reads mention records by task will never see it, and only the status row surfaces it.\\n- Left undone on purpose, per Brian\\u0027s ruling: no by-hand lever for the teammate-covered row. \\u0060h9k task add --from-pr\\u0060 (\\u0060TaskAddCommand.cs:1041\\u0060, \\u0060:1167\\u0060) and \\u0060h9k pr review\\u0060 (\\u0060PullRequestReviewCommand.cs:301\\u0060) remain owner-blind, which is a separate fix. The feed\\u0027s \\u0022deliberate kick-off\\u0022 label for a claim with an empty node id is also unchanged; the daemon claim that produced it is now
